sloka: मामाश्रितानि कान्याहुः पौरजानपदा जनाः ।किं च सीतां समाश्रित्य भरतं किं च लक्ष्मणम् ।। ७.४३.५ ॥
transliteration: māmāśritāni kānyāhuḥ paurajānapadā janāḥ ।kiṁ ca sītāṁ samāśritya bharataṁ kiṁ ca lakṣmaṇam ।। 7.43.5 ॥

translations.english: What do the city dwellers and country folk say about me, and what do they say about Sita, Bharata, and Lakshmana?
